title: Semiconductor junction balance and rectification
description:
Exact semiconductor junction transfer, depletion and field correspondence, followed by the complete forward-opening and reverse-strengthening barrier law. Maria Smith develops the Smithian Fold Theory derivation from actual doping supports through charge-field coupling and finite-history preservation to both rectification branches.

The paper includes full mathematics, arbitrary-input Lean proof constructions, ordered transfer and field projections with multiplicity, force reconstruction, exhaustive classification of 512 source candidates and 287 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations. It retains the original NIST diode comparison, all registered source fragments and the complete prediction-custody records.

Includes pinned V3/V4 citations, native proof sources, source-specific audit evidence and a portable reproduction of the original positive barrier operation. Topics: p-n junction, depletion, semiconductor rectification, forward bias, reverse bias, exact charge conservation and formal verification.

Read the complete paper PDF.
